meta.coverage: State-wise Health Infrastructure – Doctors and Specialists: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 16
meta.note: DBIE report 1570, data provider "Main". Values exactly as DBIE serves them; DBIE's unit label: ACTUAL. Periods: fiscal years, dated at April. Dimensions: Item Hierarchy Level 1; measures: required, sanctioned, in position, vacant, shortfall. Andhra Pradesh before 2014-15 is the undivided state, a separate series (Telangana was formed on 2 June 2014; 2014-15 straddles the split). Jammu & Kashmir to 2018-19 (with Ladakh) and from 2019-20 (the UT) are separate series; 2019-20 straddles the change of 31 October 2019.
